_template: Product brief / intake form (map v3.6 §3.3, card 'YOU PROVIDE'). Fill it and send to the contact in README. This file validates against schemas/intake.schema.json even before filling - the hard mechanical gate: claim must contain at least one non-whitespace character. _-prefixed keys are guidance and allowed by the schema.
claim: FILL-IN: the one claim about your model to verify, in a single sentence (example: 'the forecast error one day ahead does not exceed 5%')

code_and_settings._comment: how model variants are produced, how the best one is selected, by which rule a result is considered acceptable; saved code version; computation settings, initial values, library versions
code_and_settings.code_version: FILL-IN: link or commit hash of the saved code version
code_and_settings.settings: FILL-IN: computation settings and initial values

data_or_run._comment: either a depersonalized data fragment, or a run on your side - the data does not leave your perimeter
data_or_run.details: FILL-IN: what in the data depends on what: time, groups (objects, substations, batches), seasonality, time zone

desirable_optional._comment: optional, from §6 'desirable': run logs, history of rejected variants, known failures. If missing - the work is still possible, but part of the conclusions stays 'not enough data'. Omit the whole field if you have nothing here.
